headline: Weathered Expanse Swings Back to Colonials; Nevish Line Still Burns
war_summary: Three hours on, the great seesaw at Weathered Expanse has swung back: Colonials now hold five of nine posts against two Warden and two in ruin, after sixty-one flag actions in the past day — the war's busiest ground — though the hourly toll is easing from its peak. Kuura Strand's slaughter has cooled sharply since the evening surge, yet the flags still trade, four changes in the last two hours, the shore reading five Colonial to one Warden. Nevish Line burns on, roughly a thousand casualties a side in two hours, and the Colonials have clawed back a post, the count now five Warden to three Colonial. Linn Mercy shows the sharpest new acceleration, casualties climbing steeply about Outwich Ranch, though no flag has moved there since morning. Marban Hollow stays seesaw at four Warden, three Colonial about Checkpoint Bua; Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle both quicken, and Pari Peak has flared anew at Kohina Base. Olavis Wake and Farranac Coast have gone still. This is the war's 679th day; thirty-four victory towns remain required, and no victor is declared.
